items.source: Strategy interface used to determine the layout for a particular type of archive. Layouts may additionally implement CustomLoaderLayout if they wish to write custom loader classes.
items.translation: 用于确定特定类型归档布局的策略接口。如果希望编写自定义加载器类，布局还可以实现 CustomLoaderLayout。

items.source: Returns the location of the classpath index file that should be written or null if not index is required. The result should include the filename and is relative to the root of the jar.
items.translation: 返回应写入的类路径索引文件的位置，或者如果不需要索引则返回`null`。结果应包含文件名，并且相对于 jar 的根目录。

items.source: Returns the location of the layer index file that should be written or null if not index is required. The result should include the filename and is relative to the root of the jar.
items.translation: 返回应写入的图层索引文件的位置，或者如果不需要索引则返回`null`。结果应包含文件名，并且相对于 jar 的根目录。

items.source: Returns the location of classes within the archive.
Returns the launcher class name for this layout.
items.translation: 返回此布局的启动器类名。

items.source: Returns the destination path for a given library.
items.translation: 返回给定库的目的地路径。

items.source: Returns if loader classes should be included to make the archive executable.
items.translation: 返回是否应包含加载器类以使归档可执行。

items.source: libraryName - the name of the library (excluding any path)
items.translation: libraryName - 库的名称（不包括任何路径）

items.source: the location of the library relative to the root of the archive (should end with '/') or null if the library should not be included.
items.translation: 库相对于归档根目录的位置（应以 '/' 结尾），或者如果不应包含该库，则为 `null`。

items.source: Returns the location of the classpath index file that should be written or null if not index is required.
items.translation: 返回应写入的类路径索引文件的位置，或者如果不需要索引则返回`null`。

items.source: Returns the location of the layer index file that should be written or null if not index is required.
items.translation: 返回应写入的图层索引文件的位置，或者如果不需要索引则返回 `null`。
